# incident.io — account brief

## Who

incident.io describes itself as "All-in-one incident management — Declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack. Incident management for teams that ship software." ([source](https://incident.io/)). Its GitHub org is incident-io, which lists incident.io as its website ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).

## Production Expo signals

- eas.json is committed in incident-io/on-call-app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The app is on react-native 0.74.3 per package.json ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo runs CI workflows in .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 38 public repos and 520 followers ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).
- incident.io On-call has 3,100 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- An open issue reads "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)).
- An open issue reads "Track: upgrade to Expo SDK 53" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).
- The company is hiring a "Product Engineer, Mobile (React Native)" in London or remote UK, listed in "Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026)" ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45311640)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@incident-io-maintainer-1), top contributor to incident-io/on-call-app with 174 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)). Their profile lists company incident.io and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@incident-io-maintainer-2), 92 commits to incident-io/on-call-app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company incident.io and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Three (@incident-io-maintainer-3), 45 commits to incident-io/on-call-app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)). Their profile lists company incident.io and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.

## Why now

on-call-app was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)), and there have been 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). Two issues are open at once: an EAS build failure on iOS since the Xcode 16 image update ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)) and a track for the Expo SDK 53 upgrade ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).

## Suggested opener

You have 174 commits in on-call-app, the most of anyone on the repo ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)), and it is on react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)) with issue 198 open to track the move to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)). Issue 214 says your EAS build has been failing on iOS since the Xcode 16 image update ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)), and the repo was pushed as recently as 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)). When that iOS build is red, does the SDK 53 track stall behind it, or do you have a way to keep shipping while the image issue is open?
